findings.desc: MAJOR (both hosts; adjudicated to the Claude critic's narrower scope): the parallel-decomposition gateConsumer was added to all FOUR scope-contract facts, but scope_contract_check is a PURE READ (handler calls store.readScopeContract + buildScopeDiffPack, ZERO writeScopeContract) so it produces no input the gate consumes — registering it (and hard-asserting it in verify-process-fact-contract) locks in a producer->gate edge the runtime does not have, contradicting L4's 'commands that WRITE facts consumed by gates'. The other three (scope_contract_set/acknowledge/init_from_plan) all call writeScopeContract -> produce the durable scope-contract.json the gate reads, so they are correct (acknowledge writes the contract too — Codex's wider removal of acknowledge over-corrects vs the registry's file-granularity convention, where acknowledge already lists the other contract-reading gates). Fix: drop the parallel-gate clause from scope_contract_check's gateConsumer; remove scope_contract_check from the verify-script asserted-commands array (assert only the 3 producers, still non-vacuous); update spec §8.1 to list the 3 producer facts.
findings.resolvedReason: scope_contract_check's gateConsumer reverted to its pre-existing value (parallel-gate clause dropped) — it is a pure read (no writeScopeContract). The 3 producer facts (scope_contract_set/acknowledge/init_from_plan, all call writeScopeContract) retain the parallel gateConsumer. verify-process-fact-contract asserts only the 3 producers; non-vacuity re-proven (removing acknowledge's registration fails the check). spec §8.1 updated to list the 3 producers + state check is excluded. commit 7d905ea98.

findings.desc: MAJOR: the drift check asserts the 3 producer facts NAME the parallel gate (presence, non-vacuous) but does NOT assert EXCLUSIVITY — if scope_contract_check (or any non-producer) re-adds a gateConsumer containing 'parallel-decomposition DEV-entry gate', the check still passes. So it does not protect against the exact Round-1 over-registration regression it just fixed. Fix: after the required-producer loop, collect ALL process-fact entries whose gateConsumer matches the parallel-decomposition pattern and assert the sorted command set equals exactly [scope_contract_acknowledge, scope_contract_init_from_plan, scope_contract_set] (or at minimum explicitly assert scope_contract_check does NOT match).
